subject.title: fix(image-gen): skip invalid entries in OpenAI-compatible image response parsing

question: Should the SDK-exported strict parser return valid images from mixed valid/invalid batches, or preserve fail-fast behavior unless partial success is explicitly requested?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically coherent, and changing the exported helper's existing strict-mode semantics requires an owner decision rather than an automated repair.

options.title: Accept Partial Success
options.body: Return every valid image from a mixed batch while continuing to throw when no returned entry is parsable.

options.title: Preserve Fail-Fast Default
options.body: Keep existing strict behavior and add an explicit parser option if OpenAI-compatible providers need partial-success handling.

options.title: Coordinate Proxy Policy
options.body: Pause this patch until URL-only, object-format, base64url, and mixed-entry responses have one maintainer-approved compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Partial Success
recommendation.body: Return every valid image from a mixed batch while continuing to throw when no returned entry is parsable.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has relevant recent image-provider history and is already assigned to review this PR.
